note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is not pictured; Jesus, the woman of Samaria and the royal official are not portrayed as biblical people, and Jesus not at all; the pictures show what the verses teach through ordinary people and things of today. Nothing violent is shown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

candidates.principle: Jesus, weary from the journey, sat down at Jacob's spring about the sixth hour.
candidates.shows: Worn dusty walking boots and a travel pack set down beside an old stone well in a sunbaked field at noon.
candidates.prompt: Seen from a little distance, an old round stone well stands alone in a dry, sunbaked field at midday under a high, blazing white sun, with short hard shadows. On the ground right beside the well a pair of worn, dusty walking boots and a battered travel pack have been set down, as if a tired traveller has just sat down to rest after a long walk. The well, the boots and the pack sit in the middle of the picture.

candidates.principle: He had to pass through Samaria, and he sat down weary at the spring.
candidates.shows: Seen from above, a paved road loops far round a hot valley while one dusty footpath runs straight through it to a lone well.
candidates.prompt: Seen from high above, a wide, hot, dry valley at midday. A broad paved highway curves far out around the edge of the valley in a long detour, while one narrow dusty footpath runs straight across the middle of the valley to a single old stone well beside a lone tree. A line of footprints marks the path. Hard bright noon light.

candidates.principle: Give me a drink. How do you ask a drink from me? For Jews do not have dealings with Samaritans.
candidates.shows: Two hands meet over the top of a tall stone wall between two yards, one passing a glass of water to the other.
candidates.prompt: Two hands meet over the top of a tall, old stone wall that divides two neighbouring yards. From one side a woman's hand lifts up a plain glass of cold, clear water, and from the other side a dusty, sun-browned man's hand reaches up to take it. Only their hands and forearms are seen, against a bright midday sky, with the top of the wall running across the picture.

candidates.principle: Give me a drink. How do you ask a drink from me?
candidates.shows: Across a low stone wall a woman pours water from her jug into an empty cup held out from the far side, looking surprised.
candidates.prompt: At midday, a woman in plain present-day clothes stands on her side of a low stone wall and leans across it to pour water from her clay jug into an empty tin cup held out to her by a dusty hand reaching from the far side of the wall (only the hand and forearm are seen). Her face shows surprise. Bright noon light.

candidates.principle: If you knew the gift of God, you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.
candidates.shows: A woman strains to haul a bucket up a deep well while behind her, unseen, a clear spring pours freely out of the rock.
candidates.prompt: A woman in plain present-day clothes leans over an old, deep stone well, straining with both arms to haul up a heavy bucket on a long rope. Right behind her, where she has not looked, a clear fresh spring pours freely out of a rock face in a sparkling stream of running water. Bright midday light.

candidates.principle: He would have given you living water.
candidates.shows: Two cupped hands held under a clear stream of spring water pouring from a mossy rock.
candidates.prompt: Close up, two cupped hands are held out under a clear stream of fresh spring water pouring from a crack in a mossy rock. The bright water fills the hands and overflows between the fingers, sparkling. Clear daylight, green moss and ferns around the rock.

candidates.principle: Whoever drinks the water that I will give will never be thirsty; it will become in him a spring of water leaping up into eternal life.
candidates.shows: A spring bubbles up out of cracked desert ground and turns the land around it green.
candidates.prompt: In the middle of a wide, cracked, dry desert plain, a clear spring bubbles up strongly out of the ground, its water leaping up and running out in bright little streams. All around it the ground has turned green with fresh grass and small wild flowers, a ring of life in the bare land. Clear blue sky.

candidates.principle: The water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water leaping up into eternal life.
candidates.shows: An old stone well overflowing by itself, water spilling over its rim and running out across dry ground.
candidates.prompt: An old round stone well stands in a dry, brown field, but it is overflowing by itself: clear water wells up from inside it and spills over its rim on every side, running out across the dry ground in bright streams, with green grass springing up wherever the water runs. Fresh morning light.

candidates.principle: You have had five husbands, and the one you have now is not your husband.
candidates.shows: Five worn wedding rings lie in a row on the sun-warmed stone rim of an old well.
candidates.prompt: Close up, five worn gold wedding rings lie in a row on the sun-warmed stone rim of an old well at midday, each a little different, catching the light. Behind them the dark round mouth of the well. Bright, clear light.

candidates.principle: He told her her whole life. Sir, I see that you are a prophet.
candidates.shows: A woman at a well looks up startled, one hand on her chest, as if someone has just told her the story of her life.
candidates.prompt: A woman in plain present-day clothes stands beside an old stone well at midday, holding her clay water jug against her hip. She has just looked up, startled, one hand pressed to her chest and her eyes wide, as if someone standing in front of her has just told her the story of her whole life. Clear bright light falls full on her face. Her face is in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: An hour is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
candidates.shows: Two great mountains face each other across a valley, and between them in an ordinary field a woman kneels alone praying.
candidates.prompt: Two great mountains stand facing each other on either side of a wide green valley. Down in the valley between them, in an ordinary open field, a woman in plain present-day clothes kneels alone on the grass, praying with her head bowed, under a wide open sky in soft afternoon light. She is small but clear in the upper middle of the picture.

candidates.principle: Neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
candidates.shows: A night-shift nurse bows her head in prayer on a bench in an empty hospital corridor.
candidates.prompt: A night-shift nurse in plain blue scrubs sits on a bench in an empty, softly lit hospital corridor late at night, eyes closed and head bowed in quiet prayer, her hands folded in her lap.

candidates.principle: The true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth; the Father seeks such people to worship him.
candidates.shows: A woman with eyes closed, face lifted and hands open in a plain bare room, worshipping with her whole heart.
candidates.prompt: In a plain, quiet room with bare walls and soft morning light from one side, a woman in everyday clothes stands with her eyes closed and her face lifted, both hands open in front of her, worshipping with her whole heart. Nothing else in the room. Her face and hands are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
candidates.shows: An older man in work clothes stands alone in a misty field at early morning, cap in hand, hand on his heart, praying.
candidates.prompt: An older man in work clothes stands alone in an open field in the early morning mist, his cap held in one hand and his other hand on his heart, his face lifted and his eyes closed in quiet, honest prayer. Soft grey-gold light, dew on the grass.

candidates.principle: So the woman left her water jar and went away into the city: Come, see a man who told me all the things I did.
candidates.shows: A clay water jar stands forgotten on a well's rim while a woman runs up the road toward the town.
candidates.prompt: A big plain clay water jar stands forgotten on the rim of an old stone well at midday, left behind. Beyond it, a woman in plain present-day clothes is running away from the well up a dusty road toward a small town of white houses on a hill, one arm raised as if calling out. The jar and the running woman are both clear in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.principle: Come, see a man who told me all the things that I did.
candidates.shows: A woman hurries into a small town street, waving and calling, while neighbours step out to hear her.
candidates.prompt: A woman in plain present-day clothes hurries into the street of a small town at midday, waving one arm and calling out with an excited face. Neighbours step out of their houses and lean from windows to hear her. Bright noon light.

candidates.principle: My food is that I should do the will of the one who sent me and make his work complete.
candidates.shows: A man in an apron ladles soup for a long line of people, his own plate untouched beside him, content.
candidates.prompt: In a busy community kitchen, a man in an apron happily ladles hot soup into bowl after bowl for a long line of people. On the counter beside him his own plate of food sits untouched and forgotten, and he is smiling, content. Warm daylight from high windows.

candidates.principle: My food is to do the will of the one who sent me and complete his work.
candidates.shows: A carpenter fits the last piece into a finished table, his lunch unopened on the bench beside him.
candidates.prompt: In a carpenter's workshop in warm light, a carpenter fits the last piece into a beautiful finished wooden table, quietly satisfied. On the workbench beside him his packed lunch sits unopened and forgotten.

candidates.principle: Rabbi, eat. I have food to eat that you do not know: my food is to do the will of the one who sent me.
candidates.shows: A man ladles soup for a long line of people while a coworker holds out a plate of food to him, urging him to eat; he keeps serving, content.
candidates.prompt: In a busy community kitchen, a man in an apron happily ladles hot soup into bowls for a long line of people. Beside him a smiling coworker holds out a full plate of food toward him, urging him to stop and eat, but he keeps on serving, glowing with contentment. The plate and both their faces are in the upper half of the picture. Warm daylight from high windows.

candidates.principle: Lift your eyes and gaze at the fields, that they are white for harvest.
candidates.shows: A vast field of ripe wheat, pale gold and almost white in the bright high sun, ready to cut today.
candidates.prompt: A vast field of ripe wheat, so ripe it shines pale gold and almost white in the bright high sun, rolls away in waves to the horizon, every head heavy and ready to be cut today. Clear wide sky with a few white clouds.

candidates.principle: Lift your eyes and gaze at the fields, that they are white for harvest.
candidates.shows: A farmer straightens up and lifts his eyes over a vast field of ripe pale wheat.
candidates.prompt: A farmer in a work shirt straightens up and lifts his eyes, one hand shading his face, looking out over a vast field of ripe wheat, pale gold and almost white in the bright light, ready for harvest. He stands at the left, and the field stretches away to the horizon.

candidates.principle: The one who sows and the one who harvests may rejoice together.
candidates.shows: An old farmer and a young harvester laugh together in a ripe wheat field, holding up a sheaf.
candidates.prompt: In a ripe wheat field at harvest, an old farmer with weathered hands and a young harvester laugh together, the old man's arm round the young man's shoulders, the two of them holding up a sheaf of golden wheat between them. Bright afternoon light.

candidates.principle: Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.
candidates.shows: Young workers pick apples in an old orchard while the old man who planted it watches, smiling.
candidates.prompt: Young workers on ladders pick ripe red apples in a big old orchard, their baskets full, while at the edge of the orchard the old man who planted the trees long ago sits on a bench and watches them, smiling. Bright late-morning light.

candidates.principle: Many believed because of the woman's word; then: we ourselves have heard, and we know.
candidates.shows: On a hilltop lookout neighbours gaze at a wide view, amazed to see it for themselves, while the woman who led them stands aside smiling.
candidates.prompt: On a hilltop lookout, a group of neighbours of all ages stand together gazing out at a wide, breathtaking valley, amazed, seeing it for themselves at last. A woman who led them up there stands a little to the side, smiling at them. Seen from the side so their faces in profile show wonder. Clear morning light.

candidates.principle: It is no longer because of your speaking that we believe; we ourselves have heard.
candidates.shows: A crowd of townspeople listens intently to someone out of the picture, while a woman at the back smiles.
candidates.prompt: Outdoors at the edge of a small town, a crowd of townspeople of all ages sit and stand close together, listening intently to someone out of the picture, their faces bright and attentive. A woman stands at the back of the crowd, smiling. Clear daylight.

candidates.principle: A royal official whose son was sick went and asked him to come down and heal his son, for he was about to die.
candidates.shows: A well-dressed father sits by his feverish young son's bed at night, holding the boy's small hand, head bowed.
candidates.prompt: At night in a small lamp-lit bedroom, a well-dressed father in a loosened tie sits on the edge of his young son's bed, holding the sleeping boy's small hand in both of his own, his head bowed in deep worry. The boy rests peacefully under a blanket, flushed with fever, a cool cloth on his forehead.

candidates.principle: He went away to him and was asking him to come down and heal his son.
candidates.shows: A man in an expensive suit, tie loosened, hurries on foot down a dusty country road, his car left behind.
candidates.prompt: A well-dressed man in an expensive suit, tie pulled loose, hurries on foot along a long dusty country road, leaning forward, urgent and desperate. Far behind him his fine car stands where he left it. Overcast morning light.

candidates.principle: Go on your way; your son lives. The man believed the word and went on his way.
candidates.shows: Seen from behind, a well-dressed man walks calmly alone along a long road toward the hills, nothing in his hands.
candidates.prompt: Seen from behind, a well-dressed man walks calmly alone along a long, straight country road toward distant hills in the early evening, his head up, his steps steady, nothing in his hands. Soft clear light, the road in the upper part of the picture leading away.

candidates.principle: As he was going down, his servants met him, saying that his boy was living.
candidates.shows: On a long road a man sees two workers running toward him from far off, arms raised in joy.
candidates.prompt: On a long country road, a well-dressed man has stopped and is looking ahead, as far down the road two workers come running toward him, their arms raised high in joy. Bright morning light.

candidates.principle: The father knew it was at that hour; and he himself believed, and his whole household.
candidates.shows: A father lifts his healthy laughing son high in a sunny garden while the whole household gathers round smiling.
candidates.prompt: In a sunny garden in the morning, a father lifts his healthy, laughing young son high into the air, while the whole household gathers round smiling and laughing: the mother, the grandparents and the workers of the house. Bright warm daylight.

candidates.principle: He believed, and his whole household.
candidates.shows: A boy sits up in bed well again, his father kneeling beside him hugging him, the household crowding in smiling.
candidates.prompt: In a sunlit bedroom in the morning, a young boy sits up in bed, well again and laughing, and his father kneels beside the bed hugging him, while the mother, the grandmother and the workers of the house stand round the bed smiling. Bright morning light.
